lines: Three-head-mudgara goddess bodily is recited; of them two-eyes and also heart and two breasts indeed and.
l4.sanskrit_cite: triśiromudgaro devi kāyikī paripaṭhyate nāsāṃ netradvayaṃ cāpi hṛtstanadvayameva ca
